Get Data from Prometheus

Source: R/fct_data.R
get_data.Rd

Downloads the readings of all the sensors of a Pimoroni Enviro or Enviro+ from Prometheus, at about 1000 points in time between start_time and end_time. When these are an hour or more apart (a window of about 6 weeks or more), each point is the average of the readings since the previous one, so that the day and night cycle does not show up as noise; otherwise it is the reading at that time.

Usage

get_data(
  start_time = format(Sys.time() - 60 * 60 * 24 * 7, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz =
    "UTC"),
  end_time = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),
  urlq
)

Arguments

start_time

start time, in UTC, in this format: "2025-01-31T11:48:08Z"

end_time

end time, in UTC, in this format: "2025-02-07T11:48:33Z"

urlq

Prometheus url

Value

A data frame with the Date and the Timestamp of the readings and one column per sensor, or NULL, with a message, when the server cannot be reached or sends no data. Sensors whose readings never change are left out, as the device does not have them.

Examples

prometheus_url <- c(
  "http://pip1.crabdance.com:1507/api/v1/query_range",
  "http://pip1.crabdance.com:1505/api/v1/query_range"
)
start_time <- format(Sys.time() - 60 * 60 * 24 * 7, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
end_time <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
filtered_df <- get_data(start_time = start_time, end_time = end_time, urlq = prometheus_url[2])
head(filtered_df)
